purpose: Test fresh cross-sectional, market-relative intraday hypotheses on liquid US single stocks without reusing failed ETF/futures/FX rule families.

data.universe_rationale: Preselected highly liquid single stocks spanning technology, semiconductors, financials and energy; no post-result substitution.
data.gap_policy: No interpolation or forward fill. All signal, entry, exit, benchmark and prior-close timestamps must exist exactly.

execution.portfolio: one equal-gross market-neutral long/short pair per session; +0.5 long and -0.5 short, gross exposure 1.0, net exposure 0
execution.cost_interpretation: Weighted aggregate cost across the two legs; D0/D3 proxy, not a live fill model.
execution.reversed_same_decision_control: swap long and short using identical entry/exit timestamps and identical friction

EQ_H1_OPENING_RELATIVE_MOMENTUM.ranking_metric: log(stock 10:00 close / stock 09:30 open) - log(SPY 10:00 close / SPY 09:30 open)
EQ_H1_OPENING_RELATIVE_MOMENTUM.portfolio: long highest metric, short lowest metric across the four-stock universe

EQ_H2_OVERNIGHT_RELATIVE_GAP_REVERSION.stock_gap: log(stock 09:30 open / prior valid regular-session 15:59 close)
EQ_H2_OVERNIGHT_RELATIVE_GAP_REVERSION.benchmark_gap: log(SPY 09:30 open / prior valid regular-session 15:59 close)
EQ_H2_OVERNIGHT_RELATIVE_GAP_REVERSION.portfolio: long most negative residual gap, short most positive residual gap

EQ_H3_AFTERNOON_RELATIVE_REVERSAL.ranking_metric: log(stock 14:00 close / stock 10:00 open) - log(SPY 14:00 close / SPY 10:00 open)
EQ_H3_AFTERNOON_RELATIVE_REVERSAL.portfolio: long lowest metric, short highest metric across the four-stock universe

leave_one_name_out.method: For each of AAPL,NVDA,JPM,XOM, remove that name, rerank the remaining three using the exact same family rule and timestamps, and recompute net mean at 2 bps.
leave_one_name_out.purpose: Detect a family whose apparent edge is carried by one stock.
